function.name: list_themes
function.description: List the chart themes: Flint's presets by id, and the user's saved themes in full (their ThemeSpec JSON), to reuse one or to revise it with save_theme.

function.name: save_theme
function.description: Save a chart theme (a Flint ThemeSpec) to the user's theme library, or replace the saved theme with the same id. Saved themes are used by id like a preset in every session: a chart file's "theme", a map's view.theme, an app's <Page theme> or FlintChart theme, and the canvas theme picker. Rejected themes are not saved and the result lists every problem.

theme.description: The ThemeSpec: id (kebab-case, not a preset id), label, optional description (what it is for, at most 300 characters), optional extends (a preset id), and only the parts that differ: ink, type, structure, marks, labels, legend, dataLabels, annotation, furniture, source, facets, layout, geometry, chartDefaults, compileDefaults, interaction, variants. Colors as hex.
